supplement_related_association.product_description_long_audience_pet_ow:
Support your dog’s health, one supplement at a time
When it comes to your dog’s health, we know you want to support them every step of the way. That’s why we created ROYAL CANIN® chewable supplements, so you can give them the extra care they deserve.
Formulated by vets, approved by dogs
Suitable for adult dogs, ROYAL CANIN® Skin & Coat Adult Chews are specially formulated with a science-driven blend of ingredients, backed by over 50 years of research and observation in canine nutrition. Developed by experts, these supplements are designed to meet your dog’s changing needs and help maintain their health from the inside out.
Supports skin and coat health
ROYAL CANIN® Skin & Coat Adult Dog Chew supplements are designed to help maintain healthy skin and a glossy coat. These chews contain Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids to nourish the skin and coat, along with zinc and GLA to support the skin’s barrier function. Additionally, a blend of vitamins is included to help promote healthy skin cell turnover.
ROYAL CANIN® Skin & Coat Adult supplements are a proven success with pet owners
Don’t just take our word for it. When tested, 86% of owners reported satisfaction with ROYAL CANIN® Skin & Coat Adult Chews after just 2 months of use.*
Pair with ROYAL CANIN® diets designed for healthy pets
Our chewable supplements are designed to complement any diet within the ROYAL CANIN® range designed for healthy dogs. If your dog is on a regular maintenance diet, ROYAL CANIN® Skin & Coat Adult Chews seamlessly integrate, supporting skin health and a glossy coat. This allows your dog to maintain their existing meal routine while still receiving targeted support to help them thrive.
Follow the on-pack feeding guidelines
Be sure to follow the on-pack feeding guidelines and give your dog no more than the recommended number of pieces per day.
When giving your canine companion supplements, it is advisable to adjust the portion size of their main meal to help keep them at a healthy weight.
If you have any questions or concerns about your dog’s health, please consult your veterinarian.
*Royal Canin internal study in 105 healthy adult dogs with mild and punctual skin and coat sensitivities.

mix_feeding_best_match_association.product_description_long_audience_pet_ow:
As your dog enters their golden years, their nutritional needs undergo a noticeable shift compared to when they were puppies or adults. When they enter this phase of life, it’s important that they have a size-specific diet that helps them enjoy their senior years in good health.   

ROYAL CANIN® Mini Ageing Loaf is a nutritionally complete and balanced wet food diet specially designed to meet your small dog’s particular needs and support them throughout their senior years. This diet is suitable for small dogs that weigh up to 10kg and are over 8 years old.
 
Small dogs need lots of fuel to support their high-energy needs, even in their golden years. This specialised formula is designed to help meet your ageing dog’s energy needs and maintain their ideal weight with an adapted calorie content. 
Small dogs need a diet that supports all their movement and bones. This diet contains a blend of nutrients to help your senior dog maintain strong and healthy bones. 

No matter what breed your dog is, their coat is their crowning glory. Enriched with a blend of nutrients, this food helps keep your ageing dog’s skin healthy and their coat glossy and gorgeous. This specially crafted formula is enriched with vitamins and nutrients like EPA and DHA, to help support lifelong vitality and enjoy their senior years in good health. 

ROYAL CANIN® Mini Ageing Loaf is also available in a dry kibble: ROYAL CANIN® Mini Ageing 12+. Your dog’s sensory capacity can decrease as they get older, so mixing wet and dry food can help to enhance the palatability of their meal. treat_related_association.product_description_long_audience_pet_ow:
Reward your dog’s progress, one treat at a time. When it comes to training your dog, we understand that positive reinforcement is key. That’s why we created ROYAL CANIN® Training Treats, so you can reward your dog with these tasty chews. Formulated by vets, approved by dogs Suitable for puppies over 6 months old,

ROYAL CANIN® Training Treats are specially formulated with a science-driven blend of ingredients, backed by over 50 years of research and observation in canine nutrition. Whether you’re teaching basic commands or advanced tricks, ROYAL CANIN® Training Treats offer the perfect balance of flavour and nutrition. Low calorie treats that support brain health at all life stages

ROYAL CANIN® Training Treats contain DHA as well as vitamins C and E to help support healthy brain function from puppyhood through to their senior years. With less than 3 calories per piece, these low-calorie treats are designed to help maintain your dog’s health while rewarding good behaviour. Pair with ROYAL CANIN® diets designed for healthy pets.

Our training treats are designed to complement any diet within the ROYAL CANIN® range designed for healthy pets. If your dog is on a regular maintenance diet, ROYAL CANIN® Training Treats seamlessly integrate as a tasty reward. This allows your dog to maintain their existing meal routine while still receiving targeted training support. 

Be sure to follow the on-pack feeding guidelines and give your dog no more than the recommended number of pieces per day. When giving your canine companion treats, it is advisable to adjust the portion size of their main meal to help keep them at a healthy weight. If you have any questions or concerns about your dog’s health, please consult your veterinarian.
